caseName: Southern Pacific Co. v. Public Utilities Commission
caseNameFull: SOUTHERN PACIFIC CO. v. PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION OF CALIFORNIA
attorneys: Robert L. Pierce for appellant., Mary Moran Pajalich for appellee Public Utilities Commission of California.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to affirm is granted and the judgment is affirmed.

Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Douglas are of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted.
